claims.statement: Arrows step, Home and End reach the bounds, PageUp and PageDown move between snap points, Enter restores the default.
One implementation serves the inline and block axes; there is no second component for the other orientation.
Both regions reflow at every reachable size without introducing horizontal document overflow.
The pointer drag path is covered by the hook's unit tests rather than by these stories, because the story runner has no pointer-drag interaction kind.

component.purpose: A bounded region a person can resize with a pointer or a keyboard, on either logical axis.
component.title: Resizable

states.description: The same component on the block axis.
